ideas.pitch: A transparent supply chain tracking system leveraging graph intelligence and explainable AI to verify sustainable sourcing claims for local manufacturers.
ideas.title: EcoTrace SDG Supply Chain Audit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Sustainable Development Goals theme while incorporating graph intelligence and explainable features proven successful in the Bito AI Innovation Hackathon win.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent auditing platform that evaluates automated resume screening and shortlisting tools for gender and demographic bias.
ideas.title: BiasGuard AI Hiring Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles emerging technologies with multi-agent architecture, mirroring the winning approach of the claim-bias-evaluator at the Google Code Cure Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A localized environmental hazard forecasting tool using statistical regression models to predict regional micro-climate incidents and provide calibrated risk intervals.
ideas.title: GreenPulse Local Climate Risk Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous statistical forecasting and calibrated prediction intervals to the SDG theme, matching the 1st place Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon methodology.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized data-sharing platform enabling local communities to securely trade verified public utility datasets with explicit ownership controls.
ideas.title: CivicShare Open Data Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fulfills the Open Innovation theme with a robust working demo of data ownership tracking inspired by the Superteam Japan Cypherpunk Hackathon winner.

ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade web application featuring rPPG heart rate detection via webcam and multi-lingual health triage for under-resourced communities.
ideas.title: HealthTriage Mobile Vital Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge browser computer vision with high social impact, directly echoing the proven 2nd-place-winning mediscan-ai architecture.
